trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide-angle V-shaped depression, approximately 150 degrees, with shallow penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with small-scale peaks and valleys; the right lobe exhibits more pronounced jaggedness compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower margins with a sharp upward concavity at the distal tips, particularly prominent on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small white circular pixel clusters visible on the dark surface of both lobes, with a higher frequency on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint white linear streaks visible on the right lobe, appearing as unaligned surface scratches or rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of white scarring, depigmentation spots, and linear rake marks across the visible fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a highly distinctive, elongated upward-pointing 'hook' or falcate geometry.
